name: motion-video
description: Beat-synced 1080p motion-graphic videos in HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP) with an AI voice-over, karaoke captions, SFX and generated music.

interface.shortDescription: Beat-synced motion-graphic videos with AI voice-over and karaoke captions.
interface.longDescription: Produces a 1920x1080 30 fps motion-graphic video whose scene cuts land on the music's beats and whose reveals land on the spoken words. The pipeline is scripted end to end: facts to script, multix audio generation, forced alignment, beat grid, bar-spliced music, timeline and mix, HyperFrames HTML composition, validation, render, remux and social encode. Includes two proven visual styles, reference tooling for beat fitting and mix balance, and a project scaffold.
defaultPrompt: Make a 100-second launch video for this release with a voice-over, captions and music.
Restyle this launch video into the comic multiverse style.
